Summary: Convergence states: classifier inputs are placeholders (TURBULENT unreachable) and the MAP legend lists states the MAP cannot show
Description: 1) Original intent: the five convergence states (INSUFFICIENT SIGNAL, LOW SIGNAL YIELD, BUILDING, TURBULENT, HIGH CONVERGENCE, CLAUDE.md section 6) report measured structure, and a legend names only encodings the view actually uses (sections 1 and 16). 2) Acceptance criteria: every state is reachable from measured inputs, or a state that cannot be reached is removed from the legend; the temporal-alignment input T is derived from real data instead of a constant; the MAP either colors its edges by classifier state or its legend is removed or relabeled so it does not imply states the map cannot encode; what lime means on the MAP (edge resolved vs BUILDING CONVERGENCE) is stated once and used consistently. 3) Current implementation state (read from code, not runtime-traced): classifyConvergenceState(vector {D,V,A,T}, confidence) in src/engine/convergenceclassifier.js is called per domain by conemap.jsx, analysisfield.jsx and formationlayer/formationadapter.js. T is a constant: 0.7 in formationadapter.js line 17, 0.5 in analysisfield.jsx line 834; telemetry confidence is also constant (0.8 and 0.7). D and A are domain magnitude divided by 100; V is the spread of the domain's signal confidences, or 0.5 by default. TURBULENT needs V > 0.8 and T < 0.5, so it is unreachable because T is never below 0.5. HIGH needs D and A >= 0.75, T >= 0.6 and V <= 0.6, so it is unreachable in analysisfield.jsx (T = 0.5) and reachable only in formationadapter.js for a domain with magnitude >= 75. INSUFFICIENT and LOW appear for domains with magnitude below 10 and below 40. Most domains with magnitude 40 to 75 land on BUILDING. public/structure-field.html does not call the classifier: edges are lime when edgeResolution > 0.85, which means resolved, not BUILDING; blue, purple and gray are never drawn there, yet the five-state legend sits under the map (added in KRYL-1368 and KRYL-1371). 4) Dependencies: Founder definition of T (temporal alignment) and of V, likely a spec decision (Class E: no measured source exists today); convergenceclassifier.js (KRYL-1207), conemap.jsx, analysisfield.jsx, formationadapter.js; KRYL-1368 and KRYL-1371 (legend placement). Related Claude Web draft: specs/def-structure-field-state-legend-unwired-20261007.md on branch claude/zen-rubin-wmt234 (its first claim, that the code is not in the repository, was a stale-main artifact). 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: none known. 6) Maps to current product model: yes; section 6 state colors and section 16 direction honesty.
